files.name: Lily Pad Run — frog short
files.note: Saturday-morning frog surfing a lily pad down the river. Tongue-flicks a fly (FATALITY), rides on, and goes over the waterfall in the distance. Orchestral score and river/falls effects built locally; only spoken word is the announcer.

files.name: The Big Little Puddle — full cartoon
files.note: Milo (am_puck, 137 Hz) and Nibbles (af_bella, 218 Hz). Hierarchical biped rig, 34 bones, joint gap 0.000px verified across 181 frames. Rhubarb lip sync, MIDI score, footsteps/jump/laugh built from scratch.

files.name: Rig test — walk, wave, jump
files.note: The proof pass: both characters walking, Nibbles idle, Milo waving then jumping. Joint integrity measured at 121 sampled frames, max gap 0.000px, no bone changed length.

files.name: The Cat and the Clever Mouse — Episode 1
files.note: First full episode. Narrated by af_heart (approved), so no lip sync needed. 5 shots, 4 hard cuts, iris out. Original rigs, background, MIDI score and SFX all generated locally. Free/offline throughout.

files.note: Timed to the measured narration spans.
